close_reason: Fixed: collapsed 10 if-else blocks into a single boolean iterator expression with is_some_and
description: The 10 consecutive 'if !crlf_bad { if let Some(ref s) = mdn.X { if !check_no_crlf(s) { crlf_bad = true; } } }' blocks in handle_mdn_send step 4 are repetitive and obscure the intent. Suggested rewrite: define a helper fn opt_has_crlf(s: &Option<String>) -> bool { s.as_deref().is_some_and(|s| !check_no_crlf(s)) } and collapse to: let crlf_bad = opt_has_crlf(&mdn.subject) || opt_has_crlf(&mdn.text_body) || ... || mdn.error.as_ref().is_some_and(|errs| errs.iter().any(|e| !check_no_crlf(e))) || mdn.extension_fields.as_ref().is_some_and(|f| f.iter().any(|(k,v)| !check_no_crlf(k) || !check_no_crlf(v))); This makes the field list readable and the intent clear.
title: CRLF validation chain in handle_mdn_send should be a single iterator expression
